caption_L2L3: The top two accounts belonging to Jamie Oliver and Gordon Ramsey have the dominant shares of followers in the space, put together they have roughly the same number as the sum of the other 8 influencers. The mean follower count for the male influencers (first 5) appears to be greater than the female influencers  (last 5). However if these specified top two accounts were to be removed then the mean male follower count seems lower or similar than the female.
